name: loctree-first
description: Loctree-first repo mapping with explicit operator-grade grep fallbacks.

interface.longDescription: Pauses first-choice grep and rg mapping of the active repository, teaches the sharper Loctree path, and permits explicit command grep or command rg fallbacks with feedback to the Loctree factory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Loctree before mapping the active repository.
